about: Data-expansion corpus (research sprint 2026-09-29): new RepoBench-style repositories (hidden-test tasks mined from real fixes, validated fail-at-base/pass-with-fix) and extra click/vue-core training sessions. Claude Haiku 4.5, 60 max turns, isolated, --host-auth, confined. Arms: `train` = no hooks; `control` = Adage hooks on, directives withheld (logged in state.json). Per-call usage: each session's `calls` file (one JSON line per model call: input/output/cache_read/cache_write tokens, list-price usd, cum_usd, tool uses). Outcome: `passed` = hidden tests pass after the session. Splits: `train`/`test` follow evals/repobench/splits (chronological); `train-extra` = click/vue-core tasks older than their published train split.

setup: uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python --cache-dir {cache}/uv-cache -e . pytest pretend hypothesis tomli_w pip
